body:
Hey there! Writing copy, blog posts, and marketing content is eating up your time—but it doesn't have to. This week, we're breaking down the AI writing tools that actually deliver, so you can focus on running your business.

## This Week's Top Picks

**Notion AI**
Write, summarize, and brainstorm without leaving your workspace. Best for small teams who already live in Notion and want built-in AI without switching tools. Free + $10/mo.
[Try Notion AI Free →](https://notion.so/?ref=YOURCODE)

**Copy.ai**
Generate marketing copy, email subject lines, and social posts in seconds. Best for solopreneurs who need fast, varied copy options without the learning curve. Free + $36/mo.
[Try Copy.ai Free →](https://copy.ai/?ref=YOURCODE)

**Writesonic**
AI writer for blog posts, ads, landing pages, and more. Best for businesses running multiple marketing channels who need one tool to handle them all. Free + $19/mo.
[Try Writesonic Free →](https://writesonic.com/?ref=YOURCODE)

## Quick Tip

AI writing tools work best when you give them specifics. Instead of "write a social post," try "write a LinkedIn post for contractors about the benefits of project management software—keep it under 150 characters and include a CTA." The more detail you provide, the better the output and the less editing you'll do.
